name: makgrill
description: Local Pellet Boss controller: always-on grill bridge + Next.js dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n bridge,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @makgrill/bridge" "npm run dev -w @makgrill/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @makgrill/shared && npm run build -w @makgrill/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n bridge,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @makgrill/bridge" "npm run start -w @makgrill/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @makgrill/bridge && npm run test -w @makgrill/shared
